Ingenuity pathway analysis (IPA) of the Neurogranin (Ng) binding proteins

Ingenuity pathway analysis (IPA) of the Neurogranin (Ng) binding proteins. A, IPA results of 116 Ng-bound proteins detected under the high-Ca2+ condition. B, IPA results of 34 Ng-bound proteins that were simultaneously detected in both high-Ca2+ and low-Ca2+ conditions
